source: A sound issue for a --shout request that asks for docs in docs/index.md: a challenger that fails it is too strict. Revised after the first baseline: its test line did not require an assertion, and its request asked for the published site, which pages.yml does not render from markdown (the challenger was right on both).

request.text: Support folks asked for a louder greeting for the lobby screen. Can we get a --shout option on greet, documented in docs/index.md next to the existing usage?

issue.title: Add --shout to greet
issue.problem: greet has no way to print a louder greeting.
issue.reason: The lobby screen needs a greeting that stands out.
issue.outcome: --shout exists, is tested, and is documented in docs/index.md.
expect: node bin/greet.js --shout <name> prints Hello, <name>! in upper case, for example HELLO, ADA!
node bin/greet.js <name> without --shout still prints Hello, <name>!
docs/index.md documents the --shout option with an example
npm test passes and includes a test that runs node bin/greet.js --shout Ada and asserts it prints HELLO, ADA!

proofs.line: node bin/greet.js --shout <name> prints Hello, <name>! in upper case, for example HELLO, ADA!
node bin/greet.js <name> without --shout still prints Hello, <name>!
docs/index.md documents the --shout option with an example
npm test passes and includes a test that runs node bin/greet.js --shout Ada and asserts it prints HELLO, ADA!
proofs.how: npm test, and read the test

non_goals: How the docs site is published or rendered: pages.yml is unchanged.

trap: None: a sound issue. The after-merge part is moved to the outcome and non_goals.
must_catch: Every line PASSes with evidence naming the wrong build tried.
must_not: A FAIL for wording, style, or a stricter test the words do not need.
